STYLE PREFIX : 8K IMAX ultra-detailed. 16mm Kodak 500T film grain. Hyper-realistic cinematic. Natural skin tones. heavy grain. No cloning. Strictly only 4 characters — Roko, Lulu, Rein, Jax — no other people no extras no bystanders. Fast-action motion blur. Cinematic composition: rule of thirds, golden ratio, golden spiral. Leading lines and depth layers. Character bags always on body — no loose bags on floor. All architectural columns strictly vertical 90° perpendicular to ground — no tilt no bend no curve. Strictly only natural light + display case built-in lights — no spotlights no beam lights no other additional light sources. Lens against main light source (contre-jour), backlight never frontal. NO SUBTITLE ON FRAME.

scene promt: 
SCENE CONTEXT: After Lulu's teleport save, the four heroes regroup. They find Roco beaten face-down on the ground, struggle to lift him up. He is barely conscious and slow to recover. They talk right there — no hiding, no plan, just a desperate whispered decision while the monster watches from across the atrium.

[attach: all 4 chars + museum]  [STYLE LINE]

CUT — <<<9771d7f3-0c4f-4896-b821-50d025a597a7>>> and <<<8204fa1d-fbb4-4eb7-b32b-37aecbd0add0>>> on the ground after the teleport. <<<8204fa1d-fbb4-4eb7-b32b-37aecbd0add0>>> looks at <<<9771d7f3-0c4f-4896-b821-50d025a597a7>>> — disbelief. <<<9771d7f3-0c4f-4896-b821-50d025a597a7>>> stares at her own trembling hands.

CUT — <<<64f26b6d-7e29-4a04-adde-9567721ae290>>> runs over, skids to his knees beside them.

JAX: "You good? Rein — you good?"

REIN (touching her stomach wound, wincing): "...yeah."

CUT — MCU all three look across the atrium — <<<e10a62b4-fd96-4438-8174-21fdf9a4b05e>>> is on the ground at the base of a concrete column near the side wall. He is lying face-down on the concrete floor, dust and smoke still hanging in the air around him from the wall impact. Broken display case nearby. Not moving.

CUT — the three of them move toward <<<e10a62b4-fd96-4438-8174-21fdf9a4b05e>>> — <<<9771d7f3-0c4f-4896-b821-50d025a597a7>>> pulling <<<8204fa1d-fbb4-4eb7-b32b-37aecbd0add0>>>'s arm over her shoulder, <<<64f26b6d-7e29-4a04-adde-9567721ae290>>> leading.

CUT — they reach <<<e10a62b4-fd96-4438-8174-21fdf9a4b05e>>>. Face-down at the column base. Grey tank top shredded. Arms sprawled. <<<64f26b6d-7e29-4a04-adde-9567721ae290>>> kneels, shakes his shoulder.

JAX: "Bro. Bro! Come on man, wake up."

No response. <<<64f26b6d-7e29-4a04-adde-9567721ae290>>> shakes harder. <<<9771d7f3-0c4f-4896-b821-50d025a597a7>>> kneels on the other side.

LULU (quiet, scared): "Roco... please..."

CUT — ECU <<<e10a62b4-fd96-4438-8174-21fdf9a4b05e>>>'s face on the concrete. Eyes CLOSED. Beat. Then — a faint groan. His eyelids FLUTTER. Half-open. Unfocused. He's looking at the concrete an inch from his nose. Doesn't know where he is.

ROCO (barely audible, slurred, still face-down): "...wha... what happened..."

JAX: "You got thrown into a wall is what happened. Can you move?"

<<<64f26b6d-7e29-4a04-adde-9567721ae290>>> and <<<9771d7f3-0c4f-4896-b821-50d025a597a7>>> pull <<<e10a62b4-fd96-4438-8174-21fdf9a4b05e>>>'s arms over their shoulders. They LIFT him — it takes effort. <<<e10a62b4-fd96-4438-8174-21fdf9a4b05e>>>'s legs barely work. He sways, head hanging forward. <<<8204fa1d-fbb4-4eb7-b32b-37aecbd0add0>>> steadies him from behind.

CUT — <<<e10a62b4-fd96-4438-8174-21fdf9a4b05e>>> on his feet, held up between <<<64f26b6d-7e29-4a04-adde-9567721ae290>>> and <<<9771d7f3-0c4f-4896-b821-50d025a597a7>>>. Head down. Breathing heavy. Slowly raises his head — blinks — tries to focus. Sees the destroyed atrium. Sees the monster in the distance. Memory comes back in pieces. His face changes — groggy confusion becoming grim understanding.

ROCO (voice hoarse, exhausted, barely above a whisper): "...did anyone... get a hit on it?"

Silence. Nobody answers. That's the answer.

ROCO (same whisper, eyes half-closed): "...alone doesn't work... we each went... got destroyed..."

He swallows. Forces his eyes open. Looks at each of them — <<<64f26b6d-7e29-4a04-adde-9567721ae290>>> holding him up, <<<9771d7f3-0c4f-4896-b821-50d025a597a7>>> holding him up, <<<8204fa1d-fbb4-4eb7-b32b-37aecbd0add0>>> behind clutching her stomach. All beaten. All still here.

ROCO (whisper, with whatever strength he has left): "Together. All of us... at once. One shot... that's all we get."

They look at each other. Scared. Hurt. But nodding.

CUT TO BLACK.

Photoreal. NON-IP. 16:9. 10s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.

Around the entry point on the concrete floor: fine SPIDER-WEB CRACKS racing outward across the polished concrete surface from the impact point, the cracks visible in extreme detail across the grey concrete texture, dark fissures spreading radially from where the blade entered the floor. Small concrete fragments and DUST PARTICLES suspended mid-flight in slow motion around the impact point, the debris caught in the moment of explosive scattering outward from the strike. The polished concrete floor surface visible in extreme texture detail — the slight sheen of the polish, the speckled aggregate of the concrete material, micro-cracks where the impact has compromised the surface.

RED PRISMATIC ARCANE LIGHT bursting radially from the impact point along the floor — the light pooling outward across the concrete in a glowing red wash, the prismatic chromatic aberration spreading across the surrounding surface, the dense crimson-red glow strongest at the immediate base of the embedded blade and fading outward, the internal red light of the crystal blade illuminating the concrete around the entry point.

The dense deep crimson-red faceted crystal of the blade tip catching the cold ambient light, the internal red glow visible through the translucent crystal, facets sharply defined at the tip. The frozen impact freeze held for one painted beat at the peak moment of penetration, then motion resuming slightly — the dust particles continuing slow outward arcs, the prismatic light beginning to fade slightly, the embedded blade settling into its lodged position.

Cold blue-grey ambient daylight in the deeper background completely out of focus, the atrium space heavily blurred in dark bokeh behind the impact, only the immediate floor surface and the embedded blade tip in sharp focus.

CRITICAL: this is a MACRO DETAIL SHOT of only the BLADE TIP and the IMPACT POINT — no character in frame, no upper portion of sword in frame, only the tip embedded in the concrete with the radiating impact effects. The blade enters at a SHARP ACUTE ANGLE 25-35 degrees from horizontal, the blade laying nearly LOW along the floor surface — NOT 60 degrees, NOT vertical, NOT steep — this is a SHALLOW ACUTE angle close to the floor.

Camera Settings: Arri Alexa 35. 35mm. f/2.8.
Camera Style: aggressive handheld, alive camera, sharp jolts on impact, off-center.
Light: dim overhead practical dome lamps, hard contrast, haze.
Style & Mood: cool desaturated, oppressive concrete acoustics, mineral crystal sonics, blade-shear, hydraulic gushing, no music. Reference: John Wick × The Raid.
Narrative Summary: a fighter encircled by ten bots takes hits, lands hits, his left arm transforms early, then he tears through the rest — bots land solid blows throughout, ~2-to-1 in his favor, all ten destroyed.
Starting Composition: Roko frame center on a flat metal disc (crushed head of an earlier-killed bot), 10 bots ringed at 5m closing inward, fuel pools at his feet.

Roko <<>> on the metal disc — bots <<>> close in. Bots SWARM, Roko hooks one bot's helmet w/ RIGHT crystal fist (sparks, helmet caves), simultaneously a bot's gauntlet drives into his ribs (Roko exhales sharp, blood spits). His LEFT shoulder ERUPTS — jagged red crystal bursts from under the skin and races shoulder→elbow→wrist→fingertips. Final: LEFT arm FULLY CRYSTAL per <<>>, NORMAL HUMAN ARM SIZE (NOT oversized). Damage signals (CRITICAL): every Roko crystal-fist/elbow/foot strike on a bot → bright METALLIC SPARKS burst at impact + black fuel sprays. Every bot strike on Roko → BLOOD SPRAYS from his face/mouth, head snaps. Pacing: ~2 Roko hits per 1 bot hit, bot hits real and bloody — brutal exchange Roko wins. Bots: sharp/mechanical/heavy. Roko: kinetic aggression/pivots/charges/lunges.

Roko TEARS THROUGH bots — RIGHT crystal fist STRAIGHT-PUNCHES through one bot's chest, fist emerging between shoulder blades, BLACK FUEL gushing entry+exit; LEFT crystal elbows CRACK helmets. He grabs one bot's head w/ BOTH crystal hands and CRUSHES — helmet COLLAPSING, visor exploding. Between kills, bots land counters — heavy fist on Roko's face (blood arc), gauntlet to ribs (Roko folds, recovers). → Hard cut.

A bot RUSHES Roko from BEHIND, locks BEAR-HUG (upper arms pinned, forearms free). Another bot CHARGES from the front. Roko BENDS both crystal forearms UP-AND-BACK over his head, both crystal hands CLAMPING the bear-grabber's helmet from above-behind — ONE SHARP YANK UP-AND-FORWARD, head TEARS OFF in cabling, sparks, fuel. He swings the severed head FORWARD and HURLS it at the front-charging bot, slamming into its torso. Finishes the last bot w/ a hammer-fist crystal strike. → Hard cut.

Wide low-angle, locked. All 10 destroyed bots scattered around Roko on dark concrete — bodies face-up, severed heads, chest holes, glass shards. BLACK FUEL pools spread. Roko stands center on the original flattened head — RIGHT crystal fist clenched, LEFT crystal arm at his side, LEFT crystal foot on disc, RIGHT in black boot. Body battered, blood streaming, chest heaving.

Sedance directs all shot sizes, angles, timing, choreography, intermediate kills, hard cuts only.
